Title: Generally Available: Azure App Service - New Premium v4 Offering

Body.Content:
The new Premium v4 offering provides faster processors, NVMe local storage, and memory-optimized options, running on the latest Azure hardware. Premium v4 is available for both Windows and Linux customers, and includes sizes starting from 1 vCPU and 4GB of memory all the way up to 32 vCPU and 256GB memory.  Premium v4 delivers at least 25% better price-to-performance compared to the prior Premium v3 offering.  With updated Windows pricing, customers using pay-as-you-go can save up to 24%, with even higher discounts available in some regions through reserved instances or savings plans.

Learn more:

  • Configure Premium v4 on Azure App Service
  • Azure App Service Pricing
